# Canon materializer

Versioned build-time modules from `islee23520/seoul-dengoku-tools`, commit
`d2a5428f1af9b2b2af1c1592c72406e1e454d3da`. These modules preserve the
existing schema and rendered-lock checks. They are not shipped in the web bundle.

GDD builds do not require a tools, game, wiki, or parent checkout. Refresh this
snapshot deliberately when upgrading the canonical materializer.
